description: Observed-remove sets and replayable delta state

expected.contract: Replica0 adds value2; replica1 observes it. Replica0 removes while replica1 concurrently adds its own tag. Join retains value2. Removing after observing both tags and replaying either old add delta does not resurrect it. The ninth add by one replica fails without resetting its identity counter.
